published.citation: Addison et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 6450 +/- 120 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...823...29A/abstract

temperature.note: a companion 8.1 arcsec away gives 12% of the light (WDS 12213-5250, Mason et al. 2001) and blends into its measured spectra and catalogue colors, so the color is taken from its own temperature, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
